title: ASP (Classic Active Server Pages) — Final Assessment Blueprint
attempts: Platform-controlled; course content does not set learner-specific attempts.
question_selection: Review and publish pools only after technical review. Select a balanced subset from the protected pools and do not expose answer keys through public endpoints.
outcomes: Explain Classic ASP/IIS request execution and distinguish Classic ASP from ASP.NET.
Write and inspect VBScript and dynamic HTML with explicit input/output handling.
Use built-in objects, forms, cookies, sessions, includes, and authorization checks.
Design safe ADO access with parameterized commands, correct resource cleanup, and predictable failures.
Apply security controls for SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, sessions, file access, and diagnostics.
Plan testing, deployment, backup/restore, maintenance, and incremental modernization.

topic_distribution.topic: Templates, objects, state, forms, and organization

remediation: Review the mapped lesson and its knowledge check, then retry with an equivalent protected question set. A blueprint file does not issue a certificate; backend scoring and eligibility rules must be enforced by the platform.
version_notes: Draft. Classic ASP execution and ADO/COM behavior vary with the Windows/IIS host, database provider, component registration and process bitness. Verify all final questions against an identified target environment.
